actions.closed: This request is closed. Its history is preserved.
actions.responseHint: Asking for info and rejecting need a written response (use the box on the left). Approve sends a default one if you leave it empty.
actions.waitingOn: Waiting on {{name}}. The request returns to Under Review when they reply.

convert.createIntro: Creates a task in {{project}} that keeps a link back to {{ref}}, so the approval and decision history stays with the request.
convert.created: {{key}} created from {{ref}}. The request is now In Progress and keeps a link to the task.
convert.failed: The request could not be converted to work.
convert.how: How should the work be tracked?
convert.linkIntro: Associates {{ref}} with a task that already exists in {{project}}. The request and the task link to each other, and the task keeps its own visibility.
convert.linkableHint: Only tasks that are not already linked to a change request are listed.
convert.linked: {{ref}} is linked to {{key}} and is now In Progress. The task keeps its own visibility.
convert.noLinkable: Every task in this project is already linked to a change request.
convert.title: Convert to project work
convert.visibilityHint: Internal Only by default, like every other task. Share it later from the project’s Tasks tab.

detail.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.
detail.approved: {{ref}} approved. The client sees the new status and your response, but not your internal notes.
detail.askedMoreInfo: {{ref}} is waiting on the client for more information.
detail.assigneeFailed: The assignee could not be changed.
detail.assigneeSaved: Assignee updated. The client never sees internal assignment.
detail.cancelBody: The client sees “Cancelled”. Nothing is deleted and the history stays.
detail.estimateCleared: Estimate cleared. The client sees no time or cost.
detail.estimateFailed: The estimate could not be saved.
detail.estimateHint: Leave blank if not applicable. The client never sees “0” unless you enter zero on purpose.
detail.estimateSaved: Estimate saved. The client sees it with your response.
detail.loadFailed: Could not load this change request
detail.needsResponse: Write a response for the client first.
detail.noAutoTask: Submitting a change request never creates a task by itself. Approve it, then convert it to work.
detail.noMessages: No response sent to the client yet.
detail.noTaskYet: No task yet. A task is only created when you convert an approved request.
detail.notesFailed: The assessment could not be saved.
detail.replyPlaceholder: Write the response the client will see…
detail.responseSent: Response sent. The client is notified.
detail.subtitle: {{client}} · {{project}} · Submitted by {{name}} on {{date}}

list.description: Scope and feature changes your clients ask for. Review, estimate, decide, then convert approved ones into work.
list.empty: No change requests yet. They appear here when a client submits one from their portal.
list.emptyFiltered: No change requests match these filters.
list.title: Change Requests
